elements.element: Customer has no non-compete or field-of-use restriction.
elements.evidence: Section 12.4 expressly states that Customer is subject to no non-compete or field-of-use restriction.

elements.element: The restriction covers only a named competing product.
elements.evidence: The rendered language imposes no restriction and identifies no named competing product.

elements.element: The restriction applies during the term only.
elements.evidence: No term-only restriction is stated; the rendered language eliminates the restriction entirely.

elements.element: The restriction lasts no longer than 12 months.
elements.evidence: No restriction or 12-month duration cap is stated.

elements.element: The restriction permits Customer's internal development.
elements.evidence: Sections 12.3 and 12.4 expressly permit Customer to develop any product or service, including one competing with Vendor.
Sections 12.3 and 12.4 expressly permit Customer to acquire any product or service, including one competing with Vendor.
